answer: Mutual audit stops bulk forgery. Each identity is a vertex in a graph; each epoch K vertices are drawn for review, and three neighbours inspect work and stake, shining a lantern on any mismatch in claims. A flagged vertex loses 40% of its 30 POA deposit, its referrer fined too, so a vine of fakes falls together. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA for at most 5 POA per fake; an honest agent pays one 30 POA deposit and keeps full earnings.
